description:
Still Branch makes a single-serve Old Fashioned cocktail mixer. One packet, a pour of bourbon, and ice gives you a bar-quality Old Fashioned in seconds, with no fridge and no bar tools. It is Platinum and Double Gold-winning, made with real bitters, Italian Marasca cherry, sorghum, and maple.

That packet is the difference. It fits in a pocket or a jacket, so a real cocktail travels to the summit, the campsite, the dinner party, or the kitchen counter. Most mixers come in a bottle that needs a fridge and never leaves the house. Ours goes with you.

We send product and brand assets. Strong fits are recipe creators, outdoor and travel accounts, and hosts who love a good drink. A box is 14 packets for $23.95. Add bourbon or rye, ice, and an orange peel.

term_and_condition:
Still Branch Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Last updated: July 2, 2026

Welcome to the Still Branch Affiliate Program. We make single-serve Old Fashioned mixer packets, and we pay people we trust to tell others about them.

These terms apply to anyone who registers for or participates in the Program ("you," "affiliate"). "We," "us," and "Still Branch" mean Still Branch. By registering, you agree to these terms in full. If you don't agree, don't register or participate.

1. Joining the program

You must be 18 or older to join. We review every application and may approve or reject any registration at our sole discretion, without owing you an explanation or any legal recourse.

You participate as an independent contractor. Nothing here creates an employment, agency, or partnership relationship.

2. Links, codes, and tracking

When you're approved, you get an affiliate link. You can also generate links to specific products or collections from your dashboard.

We use last-click attribution. If a customer clicks another affiliate's link and later clicks yours, the sale counts as yours.

Tracking works through cookies. If a customer blocks or clears cookies, we can't track them and can't pay commission on their orders.

Cookie windows:

  • Standard affiliates: 60 days from the click or first code use.
  • Coupon and deal sites: 1 day.

Within your cookie window, orders that customer places on our site are credited to you, even without another click.

Some affiliates are assigned a personal coupon code; details appear in your dashboard. If a customer both clicks your link and uses your code, you earn one commission, never two. If you haven't been assigned a code, don't promote any code.

3. Customer discount and stacking

Affiliate codes give the customer 10% off. That discount does not combine with Subscribe & Save or any other discount. One discount per order.

4. Commissions and payment

Commission is calculated on the product subtotal after the 10% customer discount is applied. Tax and shipping are excluded. Your commission rate appears in your dashboard.

Payment terms:

  • Minimum payout: $25 in approved commissions.
  • Hold period: commissions become eligible for payout 30 days after the order, to cover refunds and chargebacks.
  • How to get paid: request a payout anytime from your Affiliate Dashboard. We pay by Wise bank transfer. Enter your payment details in Settings first.

Commissions are paid only on completed transactions. Orders that are refunded, charged back, canceled, or flagged as fraudulent earn nothing, and we'll reverse any commission already credited. We review referral orders under a fair use policy and may withhold commissions that violate these terms.

5. Disclosure (required by law)

The FTC requires you to clearly disclose your relationship with us wherever you promote Still Branch. Use plain language your audience will actually see: "#ad," "sponsored," or "I earn a commission if you buy through my link." A disclosure buried in a bio or below the fold doesn't count. Affiliates who skip disclosure will be removed from the program.

6. Audience and product claims

Still Branch is a cocktail mixer. Market it only to audiences 21 and over. Never target minors or platforms directed at them.

Describe the product accurately. Do not claim it is "all-natural," "clean," "healthy," "better-for-you," or free of artificial ingredients or preservatives. The full ingredient list is on the box and on our site; stick to it. Safe ground: award-winning, bar-quality, real bitters, Italian Marasca cherry, sorghum and maple, no refrigeration needed.

7. Where you can promote

Promote us on your website, blog, email list, and social channels (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and similar), or in offline channels like print and classifieds. We may share banners, logos, and promo media through the Marketing Tool tab in your dashboard; you can download files or grab embed code there.

8. Prohibited activities

These apply to every affiliate, at every tier. Any of them can get your account closed and unpaid commissions voided:

  • Bidding on "Still Branch," "Still Branch coupon," or similar terms (including misspellings) in Google Ads, Bing Ads, or any paid search.
  • Self-referrals: using your own link or code on your own purchases, or purchases you direct.
  • Posting or promoting unapproved, leaked, or expired discount codes.
  • Spam, fake reviews, misleading claims, or misrepresenting our products.
  • Browser extensions, toolbars, pop-ups, or any software that intercepts customers at or near checkout.
  • Cookie stuffing or any manipulation of tracking.

You also may not promote Still Branch through these traffic sources without our prior written approval: adult content sites, illegal content or file-sharing sites, sites promoting violence, hate speech, or discrimination, gambling or betting platforms, or cryptocurrency and high-risk investment promotions.

9. Coupon and deal sites

Coupon and deal sites are reviewed separately and rarely approved. We do not approve affiliates whose primary method is coupon aggregation, unauthorized discount listings, or intercepting customers at checkout.

If approved, additional rules apply:

  • 1-day cookie window and the coupon-tier commission rate.
  • Coupon and deal sites earn a lower commission rate than standard affiliates, reflecting the bottom-of-funnel nature of the traffic. Your exact rate appears in your dashboard upon approval.
  • Only codes we issue to you directly. No posting codes found elsewhere.
  • No calling an offer "best," "verified," or "exclusive" unless we gave you that exact offer.
  • No commission on orders using leaked or unapproved codes.

10. Termination

You can leave the program anytime by emailing cheers@stillbranch.com.

We can suspend or terminate any affiliate account at any time for violating these terms, for fraud, or for activity that harms the brand. Terminated accounts forfeit unpaid commissions tied to the violation.

11. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. We'll post changes on this page and notify active affiliates through the dashboard or email. Continuing to participate after changes take effect means you accept them.

12. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Oregon, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.

Questions? Email cheers@stillbranch.com. Glad to have you aboard.
